Saif al-Din Khader detained in Jordan

slots.name: detention status
slots.sentence: On Sunday, CBS News reported that Jordanian authorities detained Saif al-Din Khader, who uses the online moniker "Rey" and is suspected to be involved in ShinyHunters.

events.label: FBI arrests suspected ShinyHunters member in Pennsylvania

slots.name: arrest count
slots.sentence: The FBI this week arrested another individual suspected of being connected to ShinyHunters, the cybercriminal group that hacked the bureau's job website and stole personal data about its employees, FBI Director Kash Patel said on Friday.
